# `channels`

::: info
Başvuru metni WIT dosyalarından otomatik üretildiği için İngilizce.
:::

Named byte channels between mods, and between a server mod and its client half. Local delivery works since 0.2 (messages are queued and delivered on the next poll or tick, never during `send`); the network targets travel as 0xBC `CHANNEL` packets from milestone M5 and report `unsupported` until then.

Package `blockheads:api@0.3.1` · Lua table `bh.channels` · [WIT source](https://github.com/Blockheads-Club/mod-sdk/blob/dev/wit/blockheads-api/channels.wit)

Uses: `types.{mod-id, api-error}`, `players.{player}`

## Types

### `channel-id` <Badge type="info" text="type" />

```txt
type channel-id = u32;
```

A channel opened by the calling mod.

### `target` <Badge type="info" text="variant" />

Where a message goes.

| Case | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `local` | – | Every mod on this side that opened the same channel name. |
| `server` | – | The server (from a client mod). |
| `player` | `borrow<player>` | One player's client (from a server mod). |
| `all-players` | – | Every connected client running the mod (from a server mod). |

### `source` <Badge type="info" text="variant" />

Where a received message came from.

| Case | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `local` | `mod-id` | Another mod on the same side. |
| `server` | – | The server. |
| `player` | `borrow<player>` | A player's client. |

## Functions

### `open` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
open: func(name: string) -> result<channel-id, api-error>;
```

Opens (or joins) the channel `name`, which must be `<mod-id>:<name>` of a mod the caller is or depends on. Needs the `channels` permission.

### `send` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
send: func(channel: channel-id, to: target, data: list<u8>) -> result<_, api-error>;
```

Sends up to 32 KiB of bytes.

### `close` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
close: func(channel: channel-id) -> bool;
```

Closes a channel. Returns false if it was not open.
